_about: Moglia Stadium (decisions/0023): the 7,000-seat grandstand and press box along Jack Coffey Field's north sideline. A landmark: the signpost at its west end, beside the walk from Lombardi, opens its card, and a MOGLIA STADIUM plaque on the press box names it.
